profile.headline: Diagnostics Software Engineer at Cisco (via Actalent)
profile.summary:
OBJECTIVE
Looking for a senior level software development engineer role working on a real-time embedded or Linux-based product.  An ideal position would be as a principal or lead involved in the design and development of boot/BIOS/low-level/diagnostic code and performing board bring-up for an RTOS-based embedded system.

SKILLS
Languages:                            C, C++, Perl, Python, Ruby, Expect, shell, assembly (IA-32, x86, PowerPC, MC68K)
Target Processors:                 Tensilica/ARM9, Intel XScale (ARM), Intel Nehalem/Xeon, AMD Opteron/Barcelona, PowerPC 860/857, MC68K, 8051
Target Operating Systems:      Linux, VxWorks, pSOS+, VRTX, QNX 2/4/Neutrino, UNIX, MS-DOS
Development Platforms:          Windows/Linux-based PCs, Sun Servers
Platform Operating Systems:   Linux, Solaris, SCO UNIX, QNX, SunOS, Windows NT/2000/XP, MS-DOS
Platform Hardware:                 Embedded Systems, PCs
Version Control:                     Git, Perforce, CVS, ClearCase, SourceSafe

HIGHLIGHTS
Topic                  Years
C Programming        26
Board Bring-up         17
Perl Scripting           19
BIOS                        7
Embedded Systems 19
Bootloader               13

positions.title: Diagnostics Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Collaborated with hardware team (board/FPGA) to bring up new boards and devices.
* Developed Linux-based proprietary device drivers for Ethernet switches, FPGAs, ASICs, and storage devices.
* Tested devices accessed via various interfaces including PCIe, I2C, SMBus, PMBus, SPI, and MDIO.
* Crafted tools in Python and bash to make common tasks more efficient and simplify workflow.
* Mentored entry-level engineers.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · Git · Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C · Sensors

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Extended diagnostics and firmware for several new video platforms.
* Performed diagnostic- and firmware-level board bring-up on above platforms.
* Refactored diagnostics code to a standard format suitable for automated testing.
* In addition to firmware work, became responsible for generating software releases, nightly builds, maintenance of the SDK and the GUI demo app, and international shipping to our partner companies.
* Used Git and Perforce source control.
* Developed automated scripts to keep a remote Git repo and a local Perforce depot in sync.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · Git · Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: MTS
positions.description:
* Developed new features and fixed bugs in firmware for a number of different video boards.
* Wrote low-level code for new Techwell audio/video chip.
* Extended existing firmware to support new video boards.
* Performed firmware-level board bring-up on a few new video boards.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Linux · Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: Sr Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
* Participated in software design specs for next version of the BIOS and bootloader for the I/O platform.
* Worked on implementation of next release of BIOS and bootloader for new quad-core Opteron platform and existing dual-core Opteron platform.
* Implemented various enhancements and fixes for defects in embedded firmware running on an Intel XScale processor.
* Performed sustaining work on XScale-based storage platform which included handling customer escalations as well as internal defects.
* Participated in firmware design review meetings related to new storage platforms.
* Created scripted tools for use in performing code releases, debug log diagnosis, parsing of XML-based event logs, and other functions.
* Utilized Perforce and CVS for source code control.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff / Sr Firmware Engineer
positions.description:
* Worked with details from hardware design team and feature requests from platform software team to augment BIOS specification for new platform based on quad-core Intel Nehalem CPU.
* Worked closely with BIOS vendor to customize BIOS for a new platform and debug software defects on existing platforms.
* Met regularly with entire design team to discuss overall platform and firmware designs.
* Used internal wiki to “go paperless” regarding status updates, engineering notes, task tracking, etc.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Customized off-the-shelf BIOS written in MASM to work with our custom AMD Opteron-based platform (similar to a PC motherboard).  BIOS builds were generated on a Windows XP host.  Existing second stage boot code (bootloader) was modified to run on the new platform and to be invoked from the BIOS.
* Worked with hardware design team and software diagnostics team on new platform from board bring-up through product release.  Early hardware debug and hardware/software integration was performed using an ICE.
* Created a debugger script to reflash the boot code in situ rather than removing, or worse, desoldering the flash and using a device programmer.
* Implemented fixes and enhancements to platform software running on Xeon/Opteron under QNX Neutrino microkernel.
* Extended fixed dual-boot strategy to flexibly manage preferred/alternate boot pages.
* Developed and modified C and GAS assembly code and makefiles to produce bootloader builds on a Sun Fire 880 running Solaris 8 as well as a SuperMicro running Linux 2.6.  This code base was built using GCC toolchains.
* Assisted the build team with modifying their build scripts to support new products.
* All code was maintained under Perforce source control.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed unique platform based on extensive common code base (over 20 million lines of code (LOC)) from which over 100 platforms were built.
* Performed board bring-up on prototype boards.
* Worked with hardware engineers to implement low-level code as well as to debug board problems.
* Created substantial Expect script for semi-automated platform verification and testing.
* Worked in C under the VxWorks real-time operating system (RTOS) running on various PowerPC 8xx and ARM embedded platforms.
* Developed code on a Sun server under ClearCase source control via VNC connection from a Windows 2000 platform.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Designed and developed initial board bring-up strategy using boundary debug mode (BDM) debugger.  Headed board bring-up on new prototype boards.
* Worked closely with hardware engineers to implement low-level code as well as to debug board problems.
* Ported and maintained common board support package (BSP) and boot code for two different board types (system controller and echo cancellation).
* Designed and implemented live firmware download and cutover application.
* Worked in C and assembly under the pSOS+ RTOS running on a PowerPC 860 embedded platform.
* Administered Microsoft SourceSafe projects.
* Developed code on a Windows NT platform under Microsoft SourceSafe and Rational ClearCase source control.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Initially brought in on a six month contract to do bug fixes for core system controller task targeted for a Motorola 68020 based embedded system running VRTX OS.
* Developed and maintained code on central controller board for a TR-008 Digital Loop Carrier (DLC).  Worked on many TR-008 tasks within large code base (nearly 1 million LOC) as needed for enhancements and bug fixes.
* Transferred to GR-303 digital loop carrier (DLC) group to work primarily on CMISE (central office interface) and central controller task software development for second generation DLC based on VRTX OS running on an embedded Motorola 68360.
* Moved to OC-3 add/drop multiplexer (ADM) project and designed and implemented system initialization for multi-board SONET-based ADM product.
* Wrote supporting Perl scripts and helped administer ClearCase projects.
* Worked in C on a Sun workstation under both SCCS and ClearCase source control.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Developed internally multitasking program that communicated serially with our Windows-based voice system, a generic host, and the telephone switch (PBX).
* Designed and developed large C program for SCO UNIX that ran a dozen different Computer Telephone Integration (CTI) applications.
* Worked directly with customers to enhance the feature set of their particular product.

positions.title: Sr Automation Engineer
positions.description:
* Ported software that controls three-axis, stand-alone, single station dispensing machine from DOS to QNX4.
* Extended code base to work for dual station dispensing machine integrated into a conveyor-based workcell.
* Served as lead software engineer on workcell project.
* Modified QNX4 hard disk driver to control removable hard card.
* Developed QNX4 drivers for Cognex vision board, Galil motion controllers, digital I/O controller, conveyor control, and joystick.
* Extended capability of vision software after integration.
positions.insights: Skills: Embedded Software Programming · Embedded C

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
* Responsible for all aspects of interactive voice response projects from inception to completion.
* This included project management, all phases of software development, installation, and customer support.
* Utilized C++ to write system-level software and ArcheType (proprietary) for applications software.
